I am a young man here in Ntcheu, and this maize plot is what will feed my family this year. I will try to buy some fertilizer through the AIP subsidy if I can get the coupon, because without it the maize does not grow well on our tired soil, but I cannot afford the full recommended amount. I am intercropping with pigeon peas and beans like my neighbors do, and I will put some manure from the goats we keep. I cannot afford pesticides or irrigation, and we work this plot by hand with my family — maybe I will call a few people for weeding if the rains are heavy.
